      • Abhinandan Verma
        3 out of 5 stars
        Good Phone With Some Major Misses
        Reviewed in India on 31 October 2023
        Colour: Radiant Pearl
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I switched over to this one from Google Pixel, primarily for one reason : unavailability of parts and accessories. I broke my screen once and had to get a replacement at a cost of new budget phone. That pinches and doesn't feel right. Anyways, this phone is quite similar from usage point of view.

        Here are some of the Pros and Cons:

        Pros:

        1. Stock Android is always a better option. It's not available in most of the brands. In India, only Lava and Motorola are offering it I think. Motorola phones have heating issues (from reviews I've seen and read). This phone offers stock android, so no bloatware. Plus point with Lava is, they offer some customizations like Call Recording, Youtube in Background, App Lock, etc. I found that better than Google as I used to miss App Lock.

        2. Battery: Battery backup is good, lasts for 1+ day with good amount of usage (including videos, browsing, a bit of casual gaming and calls etc.). Fast charging works well in this one, charges from 25/30% to 90% in 30-45 mins. I find that quite good.

        3. All other things are normal, good to use, all functions work well. I've not noticed any particular issues in 3-4 days of continuous usage.

        Note: It's Bluetooth icon flickers while you switch Bluetooth on. It's not a bug, they've made it fancy. It's basically looking for connection, once connected, it becomes normal. I initially thought it's a bug, but realized that's how they've built it :)

        Cons:

        (Update after few months usage) I've observed an issue related to notifications on certain apps. There's a feature in phone to disable apps when not in use, it doesn't work properly and I don't receive notifications even after allowing background usage of apps. This was a big turn-off. Though it's only with 2 apps but I may not buy Lava phones in future as it's basic functionality related issue. Their development team was not able to fix it.

        Below are some nagging issues that you may find odd but may get used to them over time.

        1. Screen Size: I feel there's no need to provide 6.78 inches screen when the phone is not built like a gaming phone. Size could've been a little smaller for ease of usage.

        2. Touch: Again because of long screen size, "sometimes" you may face problem while swiping across screen (closing apps, going left-right, etc.). But, I noticed, this became smoother after installing tempered glass. Maybe it has something to do with screen sensitivity. Anyhow, again it could've been avoided with smaller screen size.

        3. Sensor: While calling, since I switched from smaller screen to longer/larger one, "sometimes" while I'm on call, the sensor doesn't respond well, as I've not gotten used to the positioning of phone till now. This is again because of larger screen size and will get better with more usage.

        4. GPS Navigation: I noticed couple of times while booking Uber, the current location it picks is not very accurate. It doesn't happen if you're at one place for long time. But if you're (say) in market, it may pick the location of your last shop rather than current one. So, be careful there. If it sustains, I'll have to speak with them and find a solution. This is the only thing I don't like about it till now, as this is important for me and relates to basic functionality.

        Neutral Points:

        1. Screen Brightness: It's bright enough in sunlight. Some reviews on youtube suggest it's less, I was concerned, but it is absolutely fine. Once you set it to high brightness, it looks fine. Though, I feel, Auto-Brightness function could've been built in better way. It doesn't adjust to environment properly. Indoor brightness remains high sometimes and it feels too bright to "my" eyes.

        2. Heating: I've not noticed any heating issues while using it. While charging, it heats up a little, but all phones do and it's normal, it cools down by the time it reaches around 90-100%.

        3. Camera: If you're not a photographer and are not very particular about every single detail in pictures, you'd find it absolutely fine. Google phones have excellent cameras. This one is not as good. But since I need it for casual usage, it's fine by me.
